_doc: M7-08 — the strings the death/revive (S13) and run-results (S14) screens show. They are ONE document because 02 §6 makes them one moment: its step 3 is 'if declined or already used, go to RUN_RESULTS with the Death completion multiplier', so the revive offer and the tally are the same instant either side of one decision. Every value is a loc key, so the content build resolves it against every locale file.  🔒 The two REWARD LINES are named -- `legendXp` and `soulShards` -- because `banked` and `payout` each caption a PAIR of figures, and a column of unlabelled numbers does not say which currency it is counting, which is 24 §9's objection to a bare number in another place. ⚠️ `soulShards` points at tuning/currencies.json's own display name instead of authoring a second one, the way the campfire's shrine rows borrow their buff names: that key is already referenced and already translated. Legend XP is not a CurrencyId and is named nowhere else, so this document authors it. 🔒 The `label` group carries CAPTIONS only: the banked and paid figures, the session-floor count and both DROP_RUN countdowns are numbers read at render time and drawn beside these words — a magnitude inside a translated string cannot be tuned. The two mercy captions exist separately because 24 §9 wants each counter to NAME ITS UNIT rather than show a bare number, and the two count different things. 🔒 `block.reviveSpent` is the only sentence about a missing revive: the run used its one. 02 §6 gives Plus subscribers an instant no-ad revive, and the ad path that would serve everyone else needs CLAIM_AD_REWARD, which is not built — so the entitled player gets a button and an unentitled player gets no control and no sentence, because a sentence about a revive route that is not built advertises a feature the game does not have. Deliberately absent: any doubled-reward figure or offer (AD_DOUBLE_RUN_REWARDS is the same deferred command), and any second revive (02 §6's limit is once per run, hard).
